verdict.rationale: Fleet-wide configuration management is a fair question for a robotics development and deployment platform. However, the evidence never describes pushing configuration changes to many robots at once or targeting robot groups. The closest items are packaging a policy into a deployment bundle and Docker or Jetson deployment. Those are adjacent single-target deployment features, not fleet configuration rollout.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can push configuration changes across many robots at once with per-group targeting
